subject: exporting cross data set to text file

messages.author: 4bc65c882faeb53e
messages.subject: exporting cross data set to text file
parts:
Dear all,
Prior to linkage mapping, I performed losts of quality controls (checkAlleles, drop.markers, calc.errorlod, replacing suspicious genotype with NA...) on my genotypic data (read.cross object) in MapMaker format. That gave me a clean data. The question is how to write this clean data (basically read.cross object) to a text file so that for future analysis, I will only load it with read.cross()?
Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] exporting cross data set to text file
parts:
Use the write.cross() function.

Alternatively, just use save() to save the R object to a file, which you can later load with load().

karl
